notes: CRM-to-contract family mapping uses deterministic filename/account-id prefix correspondence.
Invoice and registry family membership uses case-insensitive first-token substring match on billed/legal names.
Semantic candidate relations are asserted without dispositions; no SAME_ENTITY, DISTINCT, or association adjudication in P2.
TaskView referent columns use the *_referent_id suffix when a TEXT role named {referent}_id is also declared (invoice_record, contract_record).
